The central figure holds an AK-pattern rifle with a curved magazine, while the figure on the left holds a similar weapon. A third figure is partially visible in the foreground right. The background appears to be an outdoor urban or semi-urban setting.

To rigorously check for fusion artifacts where the hands grip the weapons, a common failure mode in AI generation.
To verify that the rifles are correctly positioned in 3D space relative to the bodies and do not exhibit floating or depth bleeding issues.
